body.title: Approval queue module
body.summary: A pure, vscode-free module (vscode-plugin/src/chat/approval-queue.ts) holding the ordered undecided requests {requestId, turnId, toolName?, command?, blockKind, resolution}, the current batch per originating turn {ended, decisions[]}, and the grant chain. Operations: enqueue, head (with position/total), decide(requestId, decision) refusing any id that is not the head, endTurn(turnId), batch completion check, clear() returning the undecided requests, grantChain (approved tool names, once each). No posting, no turns: the panel drives it.
acceptanceChecks: Requests keep arrival order; head() is the oldest undecided; decide() on any other id returns a refusal and changes nothing
A batch reports complete only after endTurn for its turn AND every request it raised is decided
The grant chain holds each approved tool-gate toolName once; dir-block approvals add nothing; clear() resets it and returns the undecided requests

tests.name: approval queue: requests are kept in arrival order and only the head is actionable; a decision for any other id is refused
approval queue: a batch is complete only when its turn has ended and every request is decided
approval queue: the grant chain accumulates approved tool names once each and resets on clear()
